description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's cherry-pick and cherry command functionalities. It contains test cases that set up repositories, create branches, commits, and perform cherry-pick operations to verify the behavior of Git commands in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Sets the time for the next commit to ensure unique timestamps.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified modifications.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for test validation.
